subject_group: 6.1.13 Characteristics of secondary flight control systems

versions.text: Criterion: Verify that auxiliary dive recovery devices are safe. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.2.9.3 Auxiliary dive recovery devices. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, test, demonstration, simulation, and inspection of process, requirements, design, test, and configuration documentation. Reference: MIL-STD-1797: 5.2.9.3 Auxiliary dive recovery devices
